executive_disposition.closure_statement: The confirmed Validation Department defects identified by Patch 069 have been resolved or bounded by Patches 070 through 073 without reactivating full-project validation, changing Q1 closure, or changing global ambiguity accounting.
basis: Patch 070 prevents skipped required work, missing required work, degrading warning states, and unknown required states from reducing to clean PASS.
Patch 071 prevents required zero-work stages from remaining clean-pass eligible and preserves VALID_NO_APPLICABLE_WORK as a distinct state.
Patch 072 establishes a single supported validation-environment contract and keeps environment readiness distinct from substantive validation success.
Patch 073 repaired the proven GEMINI.md mojibake spans without changing the file's instruction-authority role or mathematical meaning.
